landing.p1: Has this ever happened to you during a defense at 42 Barcelona?
landing.p2: The evaluator, with an air of superiority, runs <0>make</0> right after you've built your precious, brilliant, and completely correct project. The sacred line appears:
landing.p4: But that's not enough for them. With an unbelievable dickhead face, they type <0>touch Makefile</0>, run <1>make</1> again, and stand there waiting with moral superiority, claiming your Makefile is wrong because "you didn't add the Makefile or the headers as dependencies."
landing.p5: And you just stood there. Silent. While your blood boiled inside at such ignorance disguised as authority.
landing.p7: Your <0>Makefile</0> was flawless. The linker hadn't run in vain. There had been no relinking.
landing.p8: Confusing recompilation with relinking is not an opinion. It's pure heresy.
landing.p9: You are not alone here. Here we reveal the whole truth about Makefiles, we understand the difference, we defend clean Makefiles, and we call out the false prophets.
landing.p10: The gates of the True Relink are open. Come in.

legal.privacyS1Body: When you register with La Iglesia del Verdadero Relink we collect your email address, a password (stored only as a hash, never in plain text), and optionally a display name and an avatar image you choose to upload. We also record your chat messages and friendships within the application, as well as timestamps for your account's creation.
legal.privacyS2Title: 2. What we use your data for
legal.privacyS2Body: Your data is used exclusively to run the application: authenticating you, showing your profile to other users, enabling messaging and friendships, and keeping your session active via access and refresh tokens. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for advertising or commercial purposes.
legal.privacyS3Body: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. All communication between your browser and our servers is encrypted via HTTPS. Session tokens are managed following good security practices: the access token has a short lifespan, and the refresh token is stored in a cookie inaccessible from JavaScript.
legal.privacyS4Body: You can update your name and avatar at any time from your profile. If you wish to delete your account and its associated data, you can contact the application team to request it.
legal.privacyS5Body: We use a strictly necessary technical cookie to keep you logged in (the authentication refresh token). We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
legal.privacyS6Body: This is an academic project developed as part of 42 Barcelona. For any questions about your data, you can contact the development team.
legal.termsS1Body: La Iglesia del Verdadero Relink is a satirical academic project developed as part of the 42 Barcelona program. Its religious/ritual theme is humorous and does not represent any real belief, organization, or practice. Using this application implies accepting this tone as part of the experience.
legal.termsS2Body: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity carried out from your account. You must provide a valid email address when registering. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
legal.termsS3Body: Although the platform's tone is humorous, respectful treatment between users is expected. Harassment, incitement to hatred, and posting illegal content through chat or other features of the application are not allowed.
legal.termsS4Body: By uploading an avatar image, you guarantee that you have the right to use it and that it does not infringe third-party rights. We reserve the right to remove inappropriate content.
legal.termsS5Body: As this is an academic project, continuous availability and freedom from errors are not guaranteed. The service is provided "as is", without any warranties.
legal.termsS6Body: These terms may be updated as the project evolves. Significant changes will be reflected in the last-updated date shown above.
